where_to_look: $217m equity value with no options chain and a controlling private-equity holder (Sycamore). The capital structure - term loan balance, leverage covenant headroom, and the maturity schedule - is where a $217m equity moves 20% on a filing detail, not the comp

Store-closure cadence: Torrid has been closing stores while pushing e-commerce. The net-store-count table in the 10-Q against the closure guidance is the cleanest check on whether the plan is running ahead or behind
Sponsor behaviour: any Sycamore secondary, 13D/G amendment, or strategic-review disclosure since the last print. For a controlled small cap this dominates the operating result

Plus-size apparel channel checks: Torrid's own site discount depth and promotional cadence through July-August 2026, plus the read-across from other plus-size and value apparel reporters that have already printed the May-July quarter
Consensus is ($0.03) on 4 estimates against $0.02 a year ago - the loss/profit boundary makes the headline binary in a way a small move in gross margin decides
